author: rememes
body:
I believe that seeding when regarding tournaments could be more updated, if we had an ongoing rank status from scrimmages e.t.c. It would make teams more active on the server, to make them a higher seed. And more scrimmages, the idea would go like this.

We would either all start off with 0 points, or we fall back to the last seeds. (whoever won tourney, came 2nd 3rd e.t.c) We would then allocate an average of points for them to start off with, for example.

1: Team Allah: 4 Points
2: Team Apollo: 3 Points
3: Team China Baby Toes: 2 Point 

The teams below could either start with 1 point, and unseeded would also start with 1 point.
Draws would consist of half points.

These Rankings would last until the next tournament, and it would decide the seeds. Then It will fall back to the next tournaments results. So the two methods of moving up seeds would be winning scrims against other teams.

Although I truly believe this is a good idea, I think there a couple cons
1: Teams could repetitively play each other, meaning that teams could move up seed without deserving it. (Could have cooldowns of playing specific teams)
2: A ref would have to be there at all times, otherwise teams could lie about the score (could easily be settled with a screenshot)
The Rankings could also be held on the forums, could possibly either auto allocate points, or an admin could.

What do you guys think? This is only an idea and i would like to see what you can find that is wrong with it and I could possibly tweak it to become a suitable idea for this network xd.

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body: Here is how I believe seeding and rankings should work.  Similar to what we do in tennis tournaments, each tournaments has a number of points awarded to the team what wins.  Lets say that there is a tournament that is offering 500 points.  The winning team gets 500 points, second place gets "x" about of points, third gets "x" amount of points, and on down.  The points awarded go toward your ranking.  So since the winning team got 500 points, they would be #1 on the ranking list because they have more points.  So if another tournament is offering 100 points and another team won but the team that won the last one never won a tournament, what might happen is another team will become #1 because they have more points.  For seeding, the team with a higher ranking gets a higher seed.  So now they two best teams won't face each other until the finals.  And keep it double elimination.  So there are two completely different brackets.

replies.author: tomqss
replies.body: Having scrims to decide tournaments seedings is something which I think would be a very bad decision. Scrims serve very well as practice matches, to improve organization, try people out, etc. But they mean nothing. It's completely inconceivable that losing a few scrims could make you go down in the seeding, hence making you play against a harder team in the actual tourney, and losing because of that.
